contact.title: Contact
contact.description: A synced contact record captured from Meta (Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp) and web channels

firstName.description: First name from Meta Profile or user input

lastName.description: Last name from Meta Profile or user input

avatarUrl.description: Profile picture URL from Meta Graph

channel.description: Primary communication channel: messenger, instagram, whatsapp, or web

metaIgsid.description: Meta Instagram-Scoped ID for IG Direct

metaWaId.description: WhatsApp contact ID or phone number

locale.description: Contact locale from Meta Profile (e.g. en_US)

adTitle.description: Title or headline of the Meta Ad source

adSource.description: Source referral type (e.g. ADS, SHORTLINK, ORGANIC)

status.description: Lifecycle status: lead, subscriber, customer, unsubscribed

smsConsent.description: Explicit TCPA consent for mobile SMS/WhatsApp

messagingWindowExpiresAt.description: Timestamp when Meta 24-hour standard messaging window closes

humanAgentExpiresAt.description: Timestamp when Meta 7-day Human Agent extension window expires

recurringTokens.description: Array of active Meta Recurring Notification / Marketing Messages opt-in tokens

otnTokens.description: Array of Meta One-Time Notification (OTN) tokens

tags.description: JSON serialized or comma-separated tags applied to contact

variables.description: JSON dictionary of arbitrary dynamic captured bot variables and custom fields

customFields.description: JSON serialized custom bot attribute key-value pairs

lastInteractionAt.description: Timestamp of most recent contact activity

createdAt.description: Timestamp when contact first messaged the bot

deletion_audit_log.title: Deletion Audit Log
deletion_audit_log.description: Compliance proof record for Meta Data Deletion Policy, GDPR Right to Erasure (Article 17), and CCPA

confirmationCode.description: Unique cryptographically secure deletion confirmation tracking code

deletedContactId.description: Original ID of the purged contact record

channel.description: Originating channel: messenger, instagram, whatsapp, or web

reason.description: Reason for deletion: user_request, gdpr_erasure, ccpa_opt_out, admin_purge

purgedAt.description: Timestamp when all PII and dynamic variables were erased

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: Broadcast, drip sequence, or recurring notification marketing campaign record

type.description: Campaign type: one_time, recurring, drip, or date_specific

channel.description: Target communication channel: all, messenger, instagram, whatsapp

status.description: Campaign status: draft, active, scheduled, paused, completed

system_setting.title: System Setting
system_setting.description: Global admin configuration, kanban roadmap cards, and platform state

cards.description: JSON array of kanban roadmap cards

/contacts/{contactId}.description: Contacts and audience database synchronized with Meta channels and bot flows

/deletion_audit_logs/{logId}.description: Immutable compliance logs of completed data erasure requests

/campaigns/{campaignId}.description: Marketing broadcasts, drip workflows, and recurring notification campaigns

/system_settings/{docId}.description: Global admin configurations and kanban board cards
